rfq_details.title: Premium Screened Topsoil and Custom Grass Seed Mixtures for Municipal Landscaping
rfq_details.project_name: Premium Screened Topsoil and Custom Grass Seed Mixtures for Municipal Landscaping

introduction: Dee Davis Inc. is seeking competitive wholesale pricing for premium screened topsoil and custom grass seed mixtures to fulfill a contract with a Michigan municipal client. This is a government contract requiring reliable delivery throughout the 2026 growing season (March through November). All products will be delivered to a Metro Detroit area location. We are a certified EDWOSB/WOSB contractor based in Troy, Michigan, and require competitive pricing from qualified suppliers.

scope_of_work.title: SCOPE OF WORK
scope_of_work.description:
The supplier must provide:
1. Premium screened topsoil (1,000 cubic yards total) with delivery capability within 48 hours of order placement
2. Four custom grass seed mixtures totaling 5,500 pounds, packaged in 50-pound bags
3. Reliable delivery service to Metro Detroit area throughout the contract period
4. Quality assurance and product certifications as specified
key_requirements: Topsoil must be premium quality, properly screened with no rocks, roots, debris, or weeds
Topsoil must be natural loam (sandy loam, silty loam, or clay loam) with organic matter content
Topsoil must be pH balanced and suitable for plant growth
Grass seed mixtures must be custom blended to exact specifications provided
All grass seed must be packaged in 50-pound bags
Delivery must be available throughout March - November 2026 contract period
Topsoil delivery must be available within 48 hours of order placement
Supplier must provide product certifications and quality documentation
Payment terms: Net 30 or Net 60 preferred
Quote must be valid through February 20, 2026

items.specifications: Natural topsoil from undisturbed ground. Loam types: sandy loam, silty loam, or clay loam. Must contain organic matter (humus-bearing). pH balanced (not acidic/alkaline). SCREENED - no rocks, roots, debris, or weeds. Not excessively wet. Suitable for plant growth. Premium quality, not fill dirt.

60% Kentucky Bluegrass (various cultivars acceptable), 20% Red Fescue (various cultivars acceptable), 20% Perennial Ryegrass (various cultivars acceptable). Custom blended mixture for general purpose turf applications.
40% Red Fescue, 30% Annual Ryegrass, 20% Perennial Ryegrass, 10% Kentucky Bluegrass. Custom blended mixture for quick erosion control and fast germination.
80% Kentucky Bluegrass (various cultivars acceptable), 20% Perennial Ryegrass (various cultivars acceptable). Custom blended mixture for high-quality lawn areas.
50% Kentucky Bluegrass (various cultivars acceptable), 50% Perennial Ryegrass (various cultivars acceptable). Custom blended mixture balancing quality and quick establishment.

submission_requirements.title: QUOTE SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS
items: PRICING: Provide complete unit pricing for each line item with any volume discounts
MANUFACTURER INFO: Include manufacturer name and part number for each item
DELIVERY: Specify lead time in business days and confirm FOB terms (destination preferred)
SHIPPING: State whether freight is included in pricing or quote separately
QUOTE FORMAT: Respond via email with itemized pricing in Excel/PDF format
PAYMENT TERMS: State your standard payment terms (Net 30, Net 60, etc.)
QUOTE VALIDITY: Confirm how long pricing remains valid
CONTACT INFO: Include primary contact name, phone, and email for follow-up questions
